description: Land Acquisition - Thulhiriya, Warakapola D/S Division, Kegalle District - Kolimaduwa, Mahawewa D/S Division, Puttalam District - Pettaganwela, Meegahawela, Buttala D/S Division, Monaragala District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition declarations under the Land Acquisition Act, describing specific parcels of land to be acquired for public purposes. It includes detailed descriptions of land boundaries, locations, extents, and purposes of acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
